title: What kind of fix each pain point needed
subtitle: Every one of the 175 pain points was tagged by the kind of change that would resolve it, before anything was ranked.
note: Only 41 per cent were a software problem. A quarter were education, and the business had no channel to deliver it through, which is the gap the blueprint named.
source: Pain point triage, Time and Attendance Findings Report, October 2024.
